Maya (Marketing): quick sync 1: we need a fresh battlecard focused on production economics vs cloud + API players. short, rep-ready.
Sam (Sales): yes. reps want: 1) 1-line opener 2) 2-line value prop 3) two quick competitor zingers.
Alex (Product): call out reserved capacity, deterministic p95, and smart fallbacks. buyers care about predictability, not benchmarks alone.
Priya (Research): bench teaser: "chat p95=130ms (2k seq), embed median=50ms". will give a 1-paragraph methods note.
Owen (Field): add procurement bullets: SLA, KMS/HSM, audit logs, private deploy option. I have a customer pilot we can anonymize.
Maya (Marketing): deliverables: one-pager PDF, 6-slide TL;DR, webinar hook, subject lines. owners?
Sam (Sales): I'll own sales lines + knockouts. posting drafts by EOD.
Owen (Field): I'll prep procurement FAQ + confirm NDA for case study.
Priya (Research): Methods blurb incoming in ~2 hrs. includes config: prefix caching, continuous batching, quantization notes.
launch-bot: Tentative webinar slot booked: 2024-08-07 11:00 1 :calendar: 
Maya (Marketing): quick draft soundbites I sketched:
- 1-liner: "Redwood Inference 1 serving-first runtime: predictable latency, lower unit cost, enterprise controls."
- 2-liner: "Don't pick inference by brand. Pick the runtime that makes LLMs predictable and economical in production 1 reserved capacity, verified runtime, and quality guards."
Sam (Sales): competitor zingers:
- vs cloud: "They sell scale; we sell predictable economics and fallbacks for production traffic."
- vs DIY infra: "Skip the stitching: verified runtime + control plane out of the box."
Alex (Product): add micro-claim: "prompt-linked evals & regression alerts" so buyers know quality is guarded.
Maya (Marketing): webinar hook options:
A) "How one customer cut token spend by ~35% without quality loss"
B) "Serving-first playbook: rollouts, fallbacks, and reserved capacity"
Sam (Sales): I'll run A/B on 2k SDR list, track CTR + MQLs.
Maya (Marketing): timeline: lock assets by next Wed. I'll assemble final battlecard and landing copy. link draft folder: https://drive.redwood.example/marketing/exec-battlecards :pushpin:
Priya (Research): posting methods snippet in-thread later.
Maya (Marketing): thanks everyone 1 closing loop: Sam (sales copy), Owen (field assets), Priya (bench), Alex (sign-off), Maya (assembly). reopen if blockers.
